description: The bar chart illustrates two distinct metrics, "Accuracy (%)" and "Token Count," across a set of methods. The chart features a horizontal category axis that groups the bars into two main sections corresponding to these metrics, indicated by titles at the top left and top right. There are two vertical value axes: the left vertical axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 5, while the right vertical axis represents "Token Count" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800 with tick marks at intervals of 100. Horizontal dashed gridlines extend across the plot area, aligning with the left axis ticks. A legend at the bottom identifies the categories using colored boxes: an unlabeled red box, an unlabeled grey box, an orange box labeled "CoD", a light blue box labeled "CCoT", and a green box labeled "CoUT". The chart displays two groups of four bars colored red, orange, light blue, and green, each outlined in black and visually emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it. In the left "Accuracy (%)" group, the red bar is the tallest at 91.19, followed by the light blue bar at 88.50, the green bar at 88.40, and the orange bar, which is the shortest at 80.89. In the right "Token Count" group, the bars are visually sorted in descending order; the red bar is the tallest at 676.85, followed by the orange bar at 534.24, the light blue bar at 445.91, and the green bar, which is the shortest at 354.46.
